heroSummary: The Bambu Lab A1 handles Sunlu PETG flawlessly out of the box without requiring an enclosure or nozzle upgrade. With a 15 mm³/s maximum volumetric flow rate, it achieves reliable, high-quality printing at safe speeds up to 179 mm/s.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate with liquid glue or glue stick as a release agent
slicerTweaks: Cap the Max Volumetric Speed at 15 mm³/s in the filament profile to prevent under-extrusion at high travel speeds.
Set Pressure Advance to 0.038 s and enable a 0.2mm Z-hop on retraction to prevent nozzle dragging through sticky PETG.
Lower the first layer acceleration to 500 mm/s² and set first layer line width to 0.5 mm for enhanced initial bed adhesion.
Enable 'Wipe while retracting' (2 mm wipe distance) to mitigate fine PETG hair stringing across open travels.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Stringing and fine cobwebbing across travel gaps
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PETG absorbs ambient moisture quickly, decreasing melt viscosity and creating persistent ooze.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry the spool at 65°C for 6 hours; set OrcaSlicer retraction to 0.8 mm at 30 mm/s with 2 mm nozzle wipe.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Bed adhesion failure or edge warping on long prints
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Bed temperature set too low or oils on the Textured PEI sheet breaking adhesion on cooling edges.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Wash the build plate thoroughly with warm water and dish soap, and raise the bed temperature to 78°C.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: PEI sheet damage or excessive bonding causing surface tear-out
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PETG bonds aggressively to smooth or unconditioned PEI surfaces without a sacrificial boundary.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Apply a thin layer of PVA glue stick or Bambu liquid glue to act as an essential release interface.

faq.question: Can I print Sunlu PETG on the Bambu A1 without an enclosure?
faq.answer: Yes, PETG does not require an enclosure and prints exceptionally well in open-air environments without ambient draft sensitivity.

faq.question: Why do I need a glue stick on the Bambu Textured PEI plate for PETG?
faq.answer: PETG can fuse directly to PEI coatings; the glue stick acts as a release agent to prevent permanently ripping the PEI coating off the plate.

faq.question: Do I need to upgrade to a hardened steel nozzle for Sunlu PETG?
faq.answer: No, standard Sunlu PETG is non-abrasive, making the stock Bambu A1 stainless steel nozzle perfectly suitable for long-term printing.

faq.question: What is the true maximum print speed for Sunlu PETG on the Bambu A1?
faq.answer: At standard 0.2mm layer height and 0.42mm line width, the 15 mm³/s volumetric limit caps your safe maximum print speed at 179 mm/s.
